rules.title: Governance Specification vs Operational Ledger
statement: Governance specifications describe intended registry structure.
Operational ledgers record the current canonical state.
Specifications SHALL NEVER serve as operational authority once a live ledger exists.
Operational ledgers SHALL NOT contain proposal metadata.
Proposal history SHALL remain in governance history archives.

notes: This constitution file defines the live-ledger separation rule introduced by MPF_GOV_LIVE_LEDGER_TRANSITION_001.
Historical proposal artifacts remain preserved under governance/specifications/ and their original locations until repository-wide reference cleanup is complete.
